dataset_name: Wikipedia role-playing video game list entries

attribution.changes: Converted game tables to JSON; expanded table row and column spans; removed citation markup from values; retained reference links and source quality flags; split platform and subgenre lists; extracted first title line and listed years.
attribution.source_history: Use each revision_url and its page history for contributor attribution.

scope.included: Every data row from the main game table in all 22 chronological lists linked by the supplied index.
scope.excluded: Separate MUD, roguelike, action RPG, and tactical RPG standalone lists linked as related reading; navigation, legends and references are not game entries.
scope.record_granularity: One source table row; a title may occur multiple times for ports, regional releases, remakes, expansions, or duplicate listings. No entity deduplication has been performed.
scope.release_status: Listed years, including future years, are source claims; released versus announced status has not been verified.
scope.coverage_caveat: Complete extraction of these source tables, not a claim to include every RPG ever made.

field_notes.id: Unique snapshot entry ID, not a permanent canonical game ID.
field_notes.title: First title line with a trailing region tag removed; title_as_listed preserves the source value.
field_notes.release_year: First year in the source release cell, not necessarily the original worldwide release year.
field_notes.developer_and_publisher: Strings preserve source naming and line breaks; no entity resolution. A source cell spanning both columns is copied to each and flagged.
field_notes.platforms_and_subgenres: Split on commas and explicit line breaks only; abbreviations, annotations and slash compounds are preserved.
field_notes.missing_values: Missing scalar values are null; missing list values are empty arrays.
field_notes.country_of_origin_as_listed: Unnormalized source code; ambiguous codes such as NA are preserved.
field_notes.source_fields: Cleaned original table values, using each page’s original column headings.
field_notes.wikipedia_title_links: Only links actually present in the title cell, including red links flagged article_exists=false; links may refer to a series or shared article.
field_notes.platform_legends: Source-specific abbreviation mappings, including unresolved source labels such as Term not found.
field_notes.source.row_anchor: Snapshot HTML fragment identifier; use revision_url plus row_number if anchors change.
field_notes.source_missing_empty_column_repaired: Two rows in the 2004–2005 list (The Third Age console release and Dawn of Magic) omit an empty cell before the country code. An empty Series/Notes cell was inserted to retain the country in COO; both rows are flagged.
